d: Gold began 2026 on a historic high, but its spectacular rally has taken a painful turn. After touching record levels above $5,500 an ounce, the precious metal has plunged, raising concerns among investors and gold buyers worldwide. Meanwhile, India wants to order another 1,000 aircraft, taking its planned aviation expansion beyond 2,000 planes. But as passenger demand rises, India's aviation sector faces a growing operational crisis.
